detail: Measured 2026-09-02 during tactic-consolidation-operation verification: a --dry-run of packages/intentionsutil/scripts/consolidate-node.ts against kind-virtue with dispositionKeys [kind-virtue#1] and restatedClarifications [] printed 'clarifications: folded 1 of 6 (indices 1); 6 -> 0' with verdict permitted. planRestatement evaluates consolidationVerdict over only the caller-named dispositionKeys, so the five unfolded clarifications (whose stamps - possibly ratified, possibly absent = binding - were never consulted) would be dropped by a non-dry-run write. This matches the plan's letter (tactic-consolidation-operation.md Unit 3: input carries 'the disposition records covering the content being folded'; the operator's dry-run review and the graph-commit --base stopping point are the designed gates, and the 'folded N of M; M -> K' line is printed loudly), so it is an out-of-criteria finding, not a spec violation. The gap: a mechanical coverage guard - every clarification absent from restatedClarifications must appear in foldedClarifications, and every folded clarification's own stamps must be within the named dispositionKeys - would turn an under-declaration from a reviewable printout into a refusal. Executor-derived criterion; enters deferred pending author ratification per the bootstrap working rules.
subject: consolidate-node under-declaration bypasses the authority gate for unfolded clarifications
